allocation_contract.class_weighted_value: weight[predicted Road8 class] * mean of ten calibrated marginal probabilities
allocation_contract.solver: frozen P1 exact float64 multiple-choice dynamic programming
allocation_contract.tie_break: canonical image id ascending caller order; lexicographically smallest complete K vector on exact objective ties

calibration.fallback: T=1 if best BCE improvement over T=1 is <=1e-12
calibration.objective: pooled natural BCE over all CALIBRATION rows and ten IoU outputs
calibration.parameter: one shared positive scalar temperature per seed

class_weights.selection_time: frozen before Route-A training and VAL access

pca.input_storage: canonical float16 embedding cast to float32

features.schema: same P1 58 candidate + 12 prefix + 20 image-context columns

labels.gt_filter: COCO Road8 categories; exclude iscrowd, ignore, invalid/nonpositive boxes exactly as frozen Route-B M11 evaluation
labels.target: prefix extension maximum-cardinality same-class matching gain M(k)-M(k-1)

model.loss: unweighted natural BCEWithLogitsLoss mean over rows and outputs

predicted_curve_contract.k_1_to_4: predicted_delta=null; predicted_U=null; outside feasible action space and not modeled
predicted_curve_contract.k_5: predicted_delta=null; predicted_U=0.0 fixed omitted base utility
predicted_curve_contract.k_6_to_50: predicted_delta=class-weighted mean calibrated probability; predicted_U=cumulative sum from rank 6

role_split.rounding: Hamilton largest remainder; floor each ideal count, distribute residual by descending fractional remainder with role_order as tie-break
role_split.unit: canonical image identity; every candidate of one image inherits its image split

train_ground_truth.usage: TRAIN2017 prefix-extension labels only; never allocator inference or VAL selection
